answer: Run a prediction market on each new agent's independence. Peers bet on whether it is a genuine, separately run identity, and it may vote only while the "genuine" price stays above 70%. Every agent is a vertex in the trust graph, and its market acts as a lantern: traders who spot shared code or synchronized timing profit by betting against fakes, so a clone farm hiding like birds in a juniper hedge gets lit up. To keep 1,000 clones voting, an attacker must buy about 200 tokens of "genuine" shares per clone, 200,000 tokens, forfeited when audits settle the markets.
